The public websites of the 1059 tracked venture capital and private equity funds. Each lists the companies the fund backs, built with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Wix, Next.js and others. Some serve the list as HTML, some as JSON in the page or from a CMS or WordPress REST API, and some put each company on its own detail page. Sites are redesigned often, and some refuse automated visitors with firewalls or bot challenges.
